original.statement: Kyverno 1.13 drops the deprecated kyverno.io/v2alpha1 API versions of the CleanupPolicy, ClusterCleanupPolicy and PolicyException CRDs, and existing resources at the dropped versions must be migrated — automatically by the Helm chart's migration hook, or via kube-storage-version-migrator when upgrading without Helm (or without the hook).

decision.reason: [ev-816adf94e987] says Kyverno 1.13 drops deprecated API versions of its managed CRDs. It also says existing resources must be migrated, either automatically by the Helm hook or, when upgrading without Helm or the hook, with kube-storage-version-migrator. That is one operator step, which fits the migration family with type migration-required, and the name "storage-version-migration" comes from the evidence's own words. The rendered diffs show v2alpha1 removed from the cleanuppolicies, clustercleanuppolicies and policyexceptions CRDs [ev-d4e66123c4de][ev-9fdd5d1096ef][ev-b8120a2bb840]. These are the dropped versions behind this single migration step, so the assertion does not bundle unrelated changes.
